{{Top|leg}}
'''Muck-huts''' was the name given, by the [[Miner/Legends|miners]] of [[Apatros (colony)|Apatros]], to the pre-fabricated buildings that they lived in. All of the buildings were identical, including the same dingy shade of mud.
